trophies.name: The Limits of the Possible
trophies.detail: Collect all trophies.

trophies.name: Lilac and Gooseberries
trophies.detail: Find Yennefer of Vengerberg.

trophies.name: A Friend in Need
trophies.detail: Find and free Dandelion.

trophies.name: Necromancer
trophies.detail: Help Yennefer extract information from Skjall's body.

trophies.name: Family Counselor
trophies.detail: Find the baron's wife and daughter.

trophies.name: Something More
trophies.detail: Find Ciri.

trophies.name: Xenonaut
trophies.detail: Visit Tir ná Lia and convince Ge'els to betray Eredin.

trophies.name: The King is Dead
trophies.detail: Defeat Eredin.

trophies.name: Passed the Trial
trophies.detail: Finish the game on any difficulty.

trophies.name: Ran the Gauntlet
trophies.detail: Finish the game on the "Blood and Broken Bones!" or "Death March!" difficulty levels.

trophies.name: Walked the Path
trophies.detail: Finish the game on the "Death March!" difficulty level.

trophies.name: Geralt: The Professional
trophies.detail: Complete all witcher contracts.

trophies.name: Kingmaker
trophies.detail: Complete the subplot about choosing Skellige's ruler.

trophies.name: Assassin of Kings
trophies.detail: Take part in the assassination of King Radovid.

trophies.name: Friends With Benefits
trophies.detail: Complete the subplot involving Keira Metz.

trophies.name: Full Crew
trophies.detail: Bring all possible allies to Kaer Morhen for the battle against the Hunt.

trophies.name: Dendrologist
trophies.detail: Acquire all the Abilities in one tree.

trophies.name: The Enemy of My Enemy
trophies.detail: Use the Axii Sign to force one opponent to kill another. Do this 20 times.

trophies.name: Humpty Dumpty
trophies.detail: Kill 10 opponents by knocking them off somewhere high with the Aard Sign.

trophies.name: Environmentally Unfriendly
trophies.detail: Kill 50 opponents using the environment (e.g. swamp gas, insects or objects).

trophies.name: Kaer Morhen Trained
trophies.detail: Perform 10 effective counterattacks in a row without getting hit or parrying.

trophies.name: Can't Touch This!
trophies.detail: Kill 5 foes in a fight without taking damage (except for Toxicity) and without using the Quen Sign.

trophies.name: That Is the Evilest Thing…
trophies.detail: Ignite the gas produced by a Dragon's Dream bomb using a burning opponent. Do this 10 times.

trophies.name: Mutant
trophies.detail: Fill all mutagen slots.

trophies.name: Butcher of Blaviken
trophies.detail: Kill at least 5 opponents in under 10 seconds.

trophies.name: Triple Threat
trophies.detail: Kill 3 opponents in one fight using 3 different methods (swords, bombs, crossbow, Signs, etc.).

trophies.name: Brawler
trophies.detail: Defeat Olaf, the Skellige champion of unarmed combat.

trophies.name: Overkill
trophies.detail: Make an opponent suffer from bleeding, poisoning and burning simultaneously. Do this 10 times.

trophies.name: Master Marksman
trophies.detail: Kill 50 human and nonhuman opponents by striking them in the head with a crossbow bolt.

trophies.name: What Was That?
trophies.detail: Attack, counter, cast a Sign and throw a bomb (in any order) in under 4 seconds.

trophies.name: Even Odds
trophies.detail: Kill 2 monsters you have a contract on without using Signs, potions, mutagens, oils or bombs.

trophies.name: Globetrotter
trophies.detail: Discover 100 fast travel points.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.detail: Destroy all monster nests in the Velen / Novigrad region, or in Skellige.

trophies.name: Card Collector
trophies.detail: Acquire all gwent cards available in the base version of the game.

trophies.name: Gwent Master
trophies.detail: Defeat Tybalt and win the gwent tournament held at the Passiflora.

trophies.name: Let's Cook!
trophies.detail: Learn 12 potion formulae.

trophies.name: Bombardier
trophies.detail: Collect the formulae for 6 different bomb types.

trophies.name: Bookworm
trophies.detail: Read 30 books, journals or other documents.

trophies.name: Armed and Dangerous
trophies.detail: Find and equip all the elements of one set of witcher gear.

trophies.name: Power Overwhelming
trophies.detail: Have all possible Place of Power bonuses active at the same time.

trophies.name: Brawl Master
trophies.detail: Complete all fistfighting quests in Velen, Skellige and Novigrad.

trophies.name: Fast and Furious
trophies.detail: Win all the horse races in the game.

trophies.name: Munchkin
trophies.detail: Reach character development level 35.

trophies.name: Fire in the Hole
trophies.detail: Destroy 10 monster nests using bombs.

trophies.name: Fist of the South Star
trophies.detail: Defeat an opponent in a fistfight without taking any damage.

trophies.name: Geralt and Friends
trophies.detail: Win a round of gwent using only neutral cards.

trophies.name: All In
trophies.detail: Play three hero cards in one round of gwent and win the match.

trophies.name: Shrieker
trophies.detail: Complete the contract on the shrieker.

trophies.name: Fearless Vampire Slayer
trophies.detail: Complete the contract on Sarasti.

trophies.name: Woodland Spirit
trophies.detail: Complete the contract on the Woodland Spirit.

trophies.name: Fiend or Foe?
trophies.detail: Complete the contract on Morvudd.

trophies.name: Ashes to Ashes
trophies.detail: Complete the contract on Therazane.

trophies.name: The Doppler Effect
trophies.detail: Resolve the doppler problem in Novigrad.

trophies.name: I'm Not Kissing That
trophies.detail: Kill the prince cursed into a toad.

trophies.name: Let the Good Times Roll!
trophies.detail: Participate in all the activities at the wedding.

trophies.name: Shopaholic
trophies.detail: Buy all the items put on the block at the Borsodis' Auction House.

trophies.name: Curator of Nightmares
trophies.detail: Recreate all of Iris' nightmares in the Painted World.

trophies.name: Pacta Sunt Servanda
trophies.detail: Finish the "Hearts of Stone" expansion.

trophies.name: When It's Many Against One…
trophies.detail: Provoke all Iris von Everec's Nightmares into fighting you at the same time and defeat them.

trophies.name: Return to Sender
trophies.detail: Kill 3 opponents with their own arrows.

trophies.name: Can Quit Anytime I Want
trophies.detail: Be under the influence of seven potions or decoctions at the same time.

trophies.name: Wild Rose Dethorned
trophies.detail: Defeat all the fallen knights and loot their campsites.

trophies.name: I Wore Ofieri Before It Was Cool
trophies.detail: Collect all available Ofieri armor and horse gear, and at least one Ofieri sword.

trophies.name: Moo-rderer
trophies.detail: Kill 20 cows.

trophies.name: Rad Steez, Bro!
trophies.detail: Slide downhill uninterrupted for at least 10 seconds.

trophies.name: Killed It
trophies.detail: Win a round of gwent with a total strength of at least 187.

trophies.name: The Witcher's Gone South
trophies.detail: Travel to the Duchy of Toussaint.

trophies.name: Last Action Hero
trophies.detail: Be decorated with the Order of Vitis Vinifera.

trophies.name: Kling of the Clink
trophies.detail: Serve time in Toussaint.

trophies.name: A Knight to Remember
trophies.detail: Obtain a flawless victory in all the competitions during the knights' tourney.

trophies.name: Embodiment of the Five Virtues
trophies.detail: Be given Aerondight by the Lady of the Lake.

trophies.name: Playing House
trophies.detail: Use all available options for developing Corvo Bianco.

trophies.name: Turned Every Stone
trophies.detail: Find all grandmaster diagrams for each witcher school.

trophies.name: I Have a Gwent Problem
trophies.detail: Collect all the cards in the Skellige deck.

trophies.name: The Grapes of Wrath Stomped
trophies.detail: Help unite the warring vineyards and have a wine named in your honor.

trophies.name: Dressed to Kill
trophies.detail: Unlock the bonus for equipping all the witcher gear elements from one School.

trophies.name: Weapon "W"
trophies.detail: Develop a mutation.

trophies.name: Hasta la Vista™
trophies.detail: Kill a frozen opponent with a crossbow bolt.

trophies.name: David and Golyat
trophies.detail: Kill Golyat with a crossbow bolt to his eye.
